name: CashFlowType returns one row per label, not one per language
note: Reference-domain count. The real risk here is the LANGUAGE join: each domain cube LEFT JOINs ad_ref_list_trl, which holds a row per label per language. Without the ad_language filter in its access_policy the cube returns five rows per label and multiplies any fact joined to it. This asserts one row per label.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ad_ref_list WHERE isactive='Y' AND ad_reference_id=53385
